newsitem.title: POLAND: Rafako to resume full production in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Rafako to resume full production in Sept.

text.p: Polish industrial boilermaker Rafako SA, suspended from Warsaw bourse trade since July due to flooding, will return to full production capacity in September, the firm said in a statement on Monday.
Rafako said it would resume some production on August 1 and that it was currently appraising the damage from floods that hit its plant in the southern town of Raciborz earlier this month.
The statement said the plant was not harmed by a second series of floods which hit southern Poland during the weekend.
